stock.description: Youth Champ Financial Group Holdings Limited primarily functions as an investment holding entity. The firm directs its capital towards both public and private businesses with a presence or headquarters in Hong Kong and mainland China. INV Advisory Limited has been appointed as the investment manager for the group. Founded in Bermuda as an exempted company in April 2003, its corporate base is situated in Central, Hong Kong.
